claims.claim: Grew up on Mallorca and has spoken fluent Spanish since childhood
Piano, dance and singing lessons as a child; later entertainer at club hotels
Studied sound engineering in Cologne after school
Played festivals in Spain and posted songs and covers on YouTube as a young man
Duo KY & Nico with US rapper KY formed 2012, split 2013
Lucky L, 2014, with producer B-Case, a nod to Lucky Luke
Holding On written in 2015 for the comedy 3 Türken und ein Baby
Home, 2016, with Topic, first major hit, charted in Germany, Austria and Australia
Debut album Streets of Gold in 2018
Better with Lena Meyer-Landrut spent 26 weeks in German singles chart
Won Nickelodeon Kids Choice Award for favourite earworm on 12 April 2020, beating Forster, Bendzko and Connor
Co-wrote Mark Forster Wir sind groß
Worked on Bushido and Shindy album Classic
Contributed music to the second Fack ju Göhte film
Supported Lena Meyer-Landrut on her fifth studio album Only Love, L
From 2020 rap and hip hop collaborations as SANTOS, including Sido and Samra
Online coach on The Voice of Germany in 2019; coach from 2020, also 2021 and 2025
Won Free Eurovision Song Contest in May 2020 with Like I Love You, first singer to do so
Third album Ride has 15 new songs and came three years after the self-titled 2020 album
Over one billion global streams
Ride includes sessions with Álvaro Soler and ClockClock; Mal Amor is a duet with Álvaro Soler
All Time High released 24 October 2025
Tour listed from 29 October to 11 November 2026
Tour songs drawn from two new albums, one the first under the SANTOS alias
Hamburg stop at the Barclays Arena
